shortdesc.ph: Updates the display mode of the remote user's video view.
Updates the display mode of the remote user's video view.

section.p: You can call this method after initializing the remote user's video view to update the render mode and mirror mode. This method only affects the remote video view seen by the local user.
You can call this method to update the rendering and mirror modes of the remote user's video view. This method only affects what the local user sees.

ul.li: Please call this method after calling to initialize the remote view.
During a call, you can call this method multiple times as needed to update the display mode of the remote user's video view.
Make sure to call to initialize the remote video view before calling this method.
During a call, you can call this method multiple times to update the display mode of the remote user's video view.

section.p: After initializing the video view of a remote user, you can call this method to update its rendering and mirror modes. This method affects only the video view that the local user sees.

ul.li: Call this method after initializing the remote view by calling the method.
During a call, you can call this method as many times as necessary to update the display mode of the video view of a remote user.

plentry.pd: Render mode of the remote user's view. See .

Display mode of the remote user's video view:
RENDER_MODE_HIDDEN(1): Scales the video proportionally until it fills the view boundaries (may be cropped). Some content may be cut off.
RENDER_MODE_FIT(2): Scales the video proportionally until one dimension fits the view. The remaining area due to aspect ratio mismatch is filled with black.
